body:
## Summary
Fixes for #14 are on `main` (0.14.0), but npm `latest` is still **0.13.1**, which has both bugs. On a Docker-in-Docker agent host, 0.13.1's safe tier frees 0 B inside containers and fails on opam.

## Environment
- disk-space-saviour 0.13.1 via `npx -y disk-space-saviour@0.13.1`. `npm view disk-space-saviour versions` = 0.0.0-stage, 0.11.30, 0.12.0, 0.13.0, 0.13.1.
- dss runs in a container with the host Docker socket.
- Targets: 3 running `konard/hive-mind-dind:2.34.0` containers (DinD; default user `box`, uid 1001).

## Actual (0.13.1, `dss clean --tier safe --yes`)
**1. Every candidate inside the containers is blocked.**
- Affected: bun-cache (2.7 GiB each), cargo-registry, cargo-superseded, rust-script-cache, npm-cache, … (about 35 GiB of safe-tier items).
- Reason: `busy: cannot verify process and open-file activity`, with no diagnostic.
- Per environment: `freed 0 B`.

**2. opam fails instead of deleting.**
```
failed 22.2 MiB opam-download-cache ~/.opam/download-cache (`opam clean --download-cache` exited with 10: This version of opam requires an update to the layout of ~/.opam from version 2.2 to version 2.6, which can't be reverted.)
```
- `~/.local/bin/opam` (2.6.1) is first on PATH; the root is 2.2.
- Running it would have migrated the root irreversibly, and there is no fallback to removing the directory.

## Root cause (verified against the 0.13.1 package)
- **Containers:** `ShellEnv.openPaths()` runs `OPEN_PATHS_SCRIPT` only as the exec user. It exits 1 on unreadable root pids (`sudo`, `dockerd`, `containerd`), so `LivenessProbe.refresh()` sets `probeError` and `busyReason()` blocks every item. `main` retries with `docker exec --privileged --user 0` (`src/env/shell.js:460-482`). Read-only probe against the same 3 containers: 0.13.1 gives probeError=true; HEAD gives probeError=false, 50-53 open paths, and bun-cache is not busy.
- **opam:** the `native: opam clean --download-cache` rule (`src/rules/ecosystems.js`) is used whenever `which opam` succeeds, and `#command()` marks the item failed with no fallback. `main` removes the directory directly.

## Why it is unreleased
The "Checks and release" run 37847771589 on `main` (after PR #16) failed. The Deno tests fail at `tests/package-metadata.test.js:26` ("names the repository the release workflow publishes from"), probably fallout from the repository move. The release steps were skipped.

## Suggested fix
- Fix the Deno metadata test and publish 0.14.0.
- Optionally, as defense in depth: whenever a native cache command exits non-zero on a rule that has `paths`, fall back to the guarded removal.

## Minor (unconfirmed)
`--container 175ff931` (a prefix of the container *name*, which hive-mind sets to the session UUID) matched nothing and scanned only the host; the short container ID `025307b24048` worked.

Related: #14 (closed; same report, fixed on main), #17.
title: 0.14.0 unreleased: npm still ships 0.13.1, where in-container liveness blocks every item and opam-download-cache fails (#14 fixes not published)
